why: Gate lines that need an operator setting the Factory cannot supply. A line backed by an entry here reads WITHHELD, never PASS and never FAIL, until the setting exists and the line is run.

gate_lines: G13_oracle (suites A, B, C, D, E, G, I, O, R)
needs: a DEPLOYED instance of the product (its base URL passed as --base-url)
the product's Postgres (its *_DATABASE_URL) and embedding backend configured on that instance
SMOKE_GATE_TOKEN (or a verified smoke account) for authenticated suites
